The `sha256sums=('SKIP')` entry is expected and acceptable for VCS-based packages, as the content is inherently mutable and cannot have a fixed checksum.

The `prepare()` function removes an existing binary named `hdd_sound`, which is a routine cleanup step and not suspicious in this context. No network requests, file downloads, or system modifications occur outside of the build and packaging process.

The package installs only its own binary, license, and documentation into standard system paths, and depends only on `libpulse`, which is reasonable for a sound-related application. There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized data exfiltration, or execution of external scripts. All actions align with the stated purpose of the package.
